notes: Dermatology follow-up, oncology surveillance and a polypharmacy deprescribing visit.

cases.title: Skin lesion excision: dressings, steroid avoidance, suture removal
lines: Doctor: The mole on his back was removed cleanly, the report is benign.
Doctor: Apply the antibiotic ointment on the dressing twice a day for seven days.
Nurse: Change the dressing every two days, and clean the wound with normal saline.
Doctor: Do not use the old steroid ointment on this rash, it thins the healing skin.
Doctor: Keep the graft away from the sun, and do not use the swimming pool for a month.
Doctor: The stitches come out on Friday, the nurse will do them here.
Doctor: Use the silicone ointment on the scar at night, for fourteen nights in a row.
Nurse: Make sure to call us sooner if the area turns red, hot or starts discharging.

cases.title: Breast cancer surveillance: tamoxifen, bleeding warnings, mammogram
lines: Doctor: The markers are quiet and the report is clear, so we keep watching.
Doctor: Continue tamoxifen 20 mg every morning for the third year now.
Nurse: Make sure to report any vaginal bleeding or a new headache the same week.
Doctor: Do not start a hormone tablet from the internet, the tamoxifen does that job.
Doctor: The mammogram is due in nine months, book it before the next visit ends.
Nurse: Please arrange the appointment slot at the cancer centre, and note the date here.
Doctor: No alcohol during the tamoxifen, it adds to the liver load.
Doctor: Keep a chart of the hot flushes and bring it every Friday.

cases.title: Polypharmacy: two medicines stopped, one tapered, prn antacid
lines: Doctor: Nine tablets is too many, so today we take three of them away.
Doctor: Stop the omeprazole, the reflux has settled.
Doctor: Use one antacid tablet if the burning comes back at night.
Doctor: Take one gabapentin tablet at night for the next ten days.
Doctor: Then stop the gabapentin completely, the nerve pain has settled.
Nurse: Keep the pilbox locked, and please note which tablets were taken yesterday.
Doctor: Do not stop the blood thinner on your own, that is how strokes happen.
Doctor: We will review the whole list at the next appointment, bring every strip.
Nurse: If she feels drowsier, make sure to tell us before adding any new tablet.
Doctor: No herbal powders, no more sedatives from the last doctor.
Nurse: Bring the old strips to the clinic so we can count what is left.

items.note: 'stop' is a negation but 'gabapentin' is not one of the drug hint words, so no avoid item
